description: Adds quantity validation and extracts persist(); the bug moves @Transactional to persist, which placeOrder calls on this, the clean diff keeps it on placeOrder, which the controller calls through the Spring proxy.

bug.scenario: The controller calls placeOrder, which has no @Transactional, and placeOrder calls this.persist, a self-invocation that bypasses the transaction proxy; orders.save commits in its own repository transaction, and when stock.reserve throws OutOfStockException the order stays saved with no stock reserved.

clean.why_safe: placeOrder keeps @Transactional and is called by the controller through the Spring proxy, so persist runs inside that transaction and OutOfStockException, a RuntimeException, rolls back the saved order.
